rationale: Price has pulled back from the session high of $13.75 and is now sitting below the 9-EMA ($13.60) with the last five 1-minute candles showing a steady drift lower on declining volume, indicating momentum has stalled without a clear reversal signal. The spread and liquidity are acceptable, but entering long here risks chasing a gap-up move that has already run 5.43% from prior close with no fresh catalyst visible, while a short entry against a strongly gapped-up name with elevated relative volume (6.07x) and still-elevated positioning in the daily range (81.4%) carries asymmetric risk. With 117 minutes to close and no defined structure to trade against, the risk/reward does not justify commitment.
